fact: The second light of the Keel — a white star with a curiously blended name.
bio: Miaplacidus (Beta Carinae) is a white star about 113 light-years away, the second-brightest in the southern constellation Carina, the Keel of the ancient ship Argo.
cultural: Its unusual name appears to fuse an Arabic word for 'waters' with the Latin 'placidus' ('placid'). Deep in the southern sky, it was charted by the navigators and astronomers who mapped the far south.
